entities.summary: Marina Alekseevna Markova is a Russian volleyball player. She is 200 cm (6.6 ft) tall at 74 kg (163 lb) and plays in the outside hitter position. She plays for VakıfBank of the CEV Champions League and Sultanlar Ligi.
